newsitem.title: USA: CONXUS secures $195 million in financing.
newsitem.headline: CONXUS secures $195 million in financing.

text.p: Privately-held CONXUS Communications Inc said Monday it secured $195 million in financing and completed a $35 million private equity placement to set up a personal communication services network by September 1.

The company said it secured $195 million in financing from Motorola Inc, Glenayre Technologies Inc and Chase Manhattan Corp. Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc served as placement agent for the equity offering and Chase Manhattan's Chase Capital Partners was the lead investor, CONXUS said in a statement.
Of the total $230 million, CONXUS will use $70 million for working capital and the remaining $160 million to expand its network, said Cecil Duffie, the company's chief executive.
"We'll be looking to go public after September 1... when the network is all set up," Duffie said.
He added the company, which was set up in May 1994, had attracted $90 million in private equity placements and $80 million in financing prior to the latest capital injection.

"Today's placement bodes well for a possible public offering ... it says good things about (the company's) ability to attract further investment," said Jeanine Oburchay, a messenger industry analyst with Bear Stearns Cos Inc in New York. "A lot depends on timing,though," she added, noting messenger stocks have been lackluster the past year."
CONXUS is developing a narrow-band voice-paging network based on Motorola's InFLEXion technology and expects to introduce a pocket answering machine in September.
It has set up marketing relationships with the Arch Communications Group Inc, Metrocall Inc, MobileMedia Corp and more than a dozen other paging service providers, the company said.
